reviews.review: Mass Effect 3 Multiplayer is the GOAT!

Vraiment un superbe jeux. La difficulté étais excellente, l'immersion sublime. Le Gameplay étais très bon et l'histoire étais grandiose, meilleur que du cinéma. Je vous suggère vraiment la série Mass Effect. Vous n'aller pas le regretter ! - Dheadshot

Multiplayer is still alive and well, pretty much have had a full match in every game.
Also if you where like me and left the ME3 multiplayer before it was finished, you will be happy to know there is:
Tons of new characters including the obligatory meme volus biotic
New map variants, making experiencing some of your classic maps a bit more engaging
Mods also work to fix things like ultrawide or give you credits if you don't want to spend 300 hrs grinding credits
Long live the ME MULTIPLAYER!

Its complicated. The multiplayer is still alive and well and extremely addicting. But do not buy this game at full price. Do not buy this game for the campaign, buy legendary edition for that. Legendary edition does not have multiplayer.

If you do buy this game for the multiplayer, understand that there are hoops you will have to jump through. Sometimes it will never work, you will need to get an online key and claim the dlc. But those can be done for no additional cost. 

This game uses EA for online functionality and it is absoluteLy terrible. That said, if you can get it running with friends you are in for a hell of a ride.

better than Mass Effect 2 but worse than Mass Effect 1. Endings kinda booty even though main idea is great. This game is very good, a lot of memorable quests and moments - definitely worth it, one of the best game series ever
I'm commander Shepard and this is my favorite game on the Citadel.

Probably the greatest game i have ever played....this trilogy will always be close to my heart and this game brings it to a beautiful end. I hope to experience this level of emotions again someday but heavily doubt it.
The multiplayer holds up. Beat the game on Insanity with the legendary edition, and wanted the nostalgia kick of the multiplayer. It holds up
My favourite ending is the green one

Don't even bother. 
Oh the game is great, and apparantly the (amazing!) multiplayer is still online and thriving. 
I know this because I played the game on Xbox when it first came out. 
Steam did nothing wrong either. 

But if you buy this EA's servers won't give you the correct permissions for the N7 Digital Deluxe Edition. They'll give you the base version of the game with no dlc or online pass so you can't use the multiplayer, and trying to go through tech-support to get it fixed will involve yelling at a chatbot for several hours, before being pawned off on the most incompetent tech-support team I've ever heard of. 

Tech Support Guy 1: "This issue (our servers not recognizing which version of the game you own) is clearly a steam issue. Speak to Steam Support" Obviously lying. 

Tech Support guy 2: "Yeah, we can't fix this. It seems hard."

Tech support guy 3: "I can definately fix this!" *Gives me access to the online pass but not any of the dlc, then disconnects me from tech-support before I can follow up*

Tech Support Guy 4: *Chat window reboots itself and kicks me out, he continues talking to himself for ten minutes while I fight against the chatbot to speak to a real person again, then COMPLETELY REMOVES MY PERMISSIONS TO BOOT THE GAME AT ALL, claims that he 'fixed it' and closes my support ticket before I can get back in*

Tech Support Guy 5: "Don't worry, I can get your game permissions back again *Gives me an EA version of the game, again with no online pass or dlc, so i'm back where I started at step 1"

Tech Support guy 6: "Yeah, we enabled everything on our side (Obviously not true) reinstall your game for the 6th time and then get back to us" followed by "I'll pass this issue along to our internal team, and then message you in-game when we have a solution" 
(Obvious lie!? Does ME3 even have an in-game message functionality? Especially when you can't connect to their servers?!" 

TLDR: They lied to me, partially fixed it, unfixed it, STOLE MY GAME, gave me another version of the game that was just as broken as my original version, lied again about not being able to fix it, and then finally just gave up and pawned me off. 

And this is a bug that occurs 100% of the time with this version of the game. There are DOZENS of identical posts on EA's forums, and some of those other users had their issues solved. Some of them months ago!

So there clearly IS a fix for this. EA's tech-support has done it before. 
But apparantly only one guy knows how to do it, and nobody else is smart enough to ask them or learn? And there's no documentation?
And EA's support website is such honest dogwater that even trying to get to a tech support person to explain your problem in the first place is a massive excercise in frustration. 

Straight up, don't even bother. It's not worth it. 
Great game, 8/10. The online is absolutely immaculate. Doesn't work. EA's tech people are straight-up incapable of allowing you to run the game that you have purchased.

At least Steam let me get a full refund.

Matchmaking is broken and utilises no steam functionality to unite you with your friends. The multiplayer isn't dead, it just cannot match you together with any sort of efficacy. The system simply refuses to function at times and it is almost certainly a side effect of EA app migration. Selling this game on steam in its current form is a crime. This game DOES not work as intended. It is not fit for service. An amazing multiplayer held hostage by apathy, corporate greed and indifference.
The multiplayer is still active and its still a great co op experience
